note: v438: The loan Schedule now re-forecasts from where you actually are. Instead of walking the original fixed schedule (which dated future months as 'paid' once you'd paid ahead), it takes your true remaining balance and amortizes forward from your next real payment date. So paying extra pulls your payoff date IN and shrinks the payment count; falling behind pushes it out. New 'Projected payoff' card shows the adjusted date vs. the original, the Schedule shows only what's left ('N payments left · X of Y made', next payment highlighted), the payment calendar marks recorded payments as paid and projected ones as upcoming, and the Dashboard calendar/upcoming + payment-modal all use the same real next-payment date. On-time payers see no change.
